title: lepidium montanum subsp. spathulatum
intro: Lepidium montanum subsp. spathulatum, commonly known as Mountain Pepper Cress or Peppergrass, is a plant species in the mustard family (Brassicaceae). This plant is used for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and alleviate symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). The therapeutic actions of Lepidium montanum subsp. spathulatum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as glucosinolates and alkaloids. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to contribute to its therapeutic effects, although more research is needed to fully understand its medicinal properties.
